beforeImage.name: Electrada
beforeImage.description: Electrada provides electric-fleet charging infrastructure and electric-fuel management solutions for commercial vehicle operators. Its customer base includes fleets that want to electrify without funding charging infrastructure through large upfront capital expenditure. The operating model is asset-heavy and contracted because the company finances, owns, and manages charging infrastructure under long-term service and performance arrangements. Company materials state that the platform launched in 2020 and markets a zero-capex model with uptime and performance commitments to fleet operators. Its deployment footprint spans multiple US states across fleet, municipal, and commercial transportation use cases. BlackRock led Electrada's Series B funding in 2021 and added follow-on capital in 2023, while public sources do not disclose the precise ownership percentage.

afterImage.name: Electrada
afterImage.description: Electrada, LLC was a U.S. commercial fleet-charging platform that financed, owned and managed charging infrastructure under charging-as-a-service arrangements. Launched in 2020 and headquartered in Cincinnati, the company served commercial, institutional and public fleets through no-upfront-capex infrastructure and energy-management contracts. BlackRock Climate Infrastructure backed Electrada beginning in 2021, but the exact fund, vehicle and stake were not publicly disclosed. On April 20, 2026, Current Trucking acquired Electrada's operating, construction and development assets, more than 30 sites, customer agreements and select personnel. On June 17, 2026, Inspiration Mobility acquired select remaining assets, team, pipeline, depot-development capability, energy software and intellectual property. Those transactions ended Electrada as a standalone operating platform; neither buyer is treated as a full legal successor and no GIP ownership period exists.
